a.xlink:title: Implements the main server logic for the R-Type project.
High-level game protocol facade (header only).
Header for CollisionSystem — orchestrates broad-phase and narrow-phase checks.
Header for MovementSystem — system that advances entity positions.
Defines the SpawnerSystem class used for entity spawning logic in the ECS.
Header for PlayerSystem — ECS system handling player movement, firing, and score updates.
Declares the entity creation and component registration helpers.
High-level facade that connects entity/component/system managers.
Low-level UDP protocol singleton interface (signatures only).
Command-line and configuration file parsing for the R-Type server.
Defines the ServerClock class used for precise tick-based timing control.
Entity creation and lifecycle manager for the ECS.
Manager for registering systems and maintaining execution signatures.
Manager for registering and accessing component arrays in the ECS.
Global configuration macros for the ECS (component/entity limits).
Base class for systems in the ECS.
Component storage implementation for the ECS.
Abstract base interface for component container types.
Core protocol type definitions (packet headers, flags, events).
Game-level protocol type definitions (payloads, game enums).
Spatial-hash collision world API: grid building and narrow-phase tests.
ECS component representing the position of an entity in 2D space.
ECS component defining the hitbox dimensions of an entity.
ECS component representing directional movement in 2D space.
Defines the DrawSystem class responsible for rendering all drawable entities in the ECS.
ECS component representing an entity's movement speed.
ECS component representing an entity’s score state.
ECS component representing the frequency of an action or event.
ECS component representing the visual sprite of an entity.
Declaration of the rtype::client::InputManager class.
Declaration of the rtype::client::LanguageManager singleton class.
Declaration of the ResourceManager singleton handling game asset caching.
Declaration of the rtype::client::SceneManager class.
Declaration of the GameSettings singleton managing client runtime and rendering configuration.
Custom exception class for R-Type-specific runtime errors.
Declaration of the rtype::client::IScene interface.
ECS component representing an entity's health state.
